scope: OpenLORIS corridor1-1 tier-1000, frozen local features/verifier/mapper

retrieval.policy: K=32 reciprocal retrieval AND descriptor-only sequence_support>=2, minimum frame gap 64
retrieval.binding: canonical rig order and frozen snapshot image names are revalidated; existing pairs and duplicate ownership are rejected before atomic publication

matching.recipe: ratio=0.8, cross-check, full verifier, min_matches=12, persistent streamed features, shared snapshot envelope, 32 pairs/shard, RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4
matching.discarded_probe: A first isolated run accidentally used the runner default min_matches=30. It was retained externally as diagnostic evidence but was not merged or used for the A/B.

measurement_contract.environment: RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1; debug and phase-timing variables unset
measurement_contract.memory: one dedicated cgroup v2 scope per arm, MemoryMax=2G, MemorySwapMax=0, 50 ms aggregate-RSS sampling
measurement_contract.promotion_gate: candidate must be no worse in registration, RMSE, p95, mean reprojection, mapper wall, and sampled peak RSS

default_track_builder_ab.failure: registration, RMSE, p95, reprojection, and RSS regress; no repeat or larger tier is allowed

pair_confidence_diagnostic.description: The existing production pair-confidence track builder was applied identically to control and candidate to test whether conflict ordering alone could contain the added edges.
pair_confidence_diagnostic.failure: registration recovers, but every remaining quality/resource gate regresses

decision.accepted_claim: restart-safe learned descriptor storage and bounded ANN infrastructure remain valid
decision.rejected_claim: this K=32 all-edge learned-retrieval candidate improves SfM quality or end-to-end performance
decision.cause: The corridor descriptors form a broad high-similarity pool and 10919 of 10958 additions pass the permissive frozen two-view verifier. Hard insertion before track construction over-connects repetitive correspondences; confidence ordering does not recover trajectory quality or resource parity.
decision.next_hypothesis: Before any new mapping run, add a bounded descriptor-only ambiguity gate (rank margin plus bidirectional sequence path, with a fixed per-frame addition budget) and audit its 1k survival curve. Keep the matcher/verifier frozen and rerun the same fail-fast 1k A/B only for a materially smaller predeclared candidate set.
